title: Implement Request Body Parsing and Validation
description: This feature will enable yantraverse to handle JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, improving support for RESTful APIs and web applications. It will also include validation to ensure that the parsed data conforms to expected formats, enhancing security and reliability. By adding this feature, yantraverse will become more versatile and attractive to developers building data-driven applications
testCases: Test validation for missing required fields
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the framework can correctly parse and validate request bodies for JSON and URL-encoded formats, and when error handling and logging are properly implemented for invalid or missing data
reason: This feature is crucial for supporting modern web development use cases, and its implementation will significantly enhance the framework's usability and competitiveness
